recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, weathered portrait of a young child layered beneath semi-transparent, distressed bureaucratic text and official document markings. The image features heavy physical degradation including creases, scratches, and worn edges, simulating a decades-old government ID or visa.
coreVisualRelationships: Text as a physical barrier/veil over the human subject
Contrast between the warmth of the portrait and the coldness of the data
Heavy textural noise unifying the background and foreground layers
coreInvariants: Simulated physical paper damage (creases, white cracks)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The child's face is centrally framed, filling approximately 70% of the vertical space, with eyes positioned at the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The child's eyes and smile, which remain visible through the textural noise and text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central face, then scans the perimeter text, following the horizontal lines of the 'document' data.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with text and texture to create a claustrophobic, official feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and brown tones in the portrait skin and hair.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated blues and grays in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the text and the 'cracked' paper texture.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high local contrast in the texture; values are compressed to mimic old film photography.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and faded primary colors

characterSpecificRedesigns: Simulated horizontal strike-throughs on specific text lines
Variable opacity to suggest uneven ink or wear
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights of the same sans-serif family to distinguish between 'labels' and 'input data'.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary bureaucratic, mid-century official look.
Neutral and authoritative for government-style documents.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a young child with a warm smile, shot on 35mm film with visible grain. Apply a heavy 'distressed paper' texture with white creases, scratches, and worn edges. Desaturate the background elements.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay multiple lines of white sans-serif text in varying sizes, mimicking a visa document. Use horizontal strike-throughs on the top lines. Set text opacity to 70% and apply a displacement map so the text follows the paper creases.

verificationChecks: Text must look integrated into the paper texture, not floating on top.
The child's eyes must remain the focal point despite the text.
The 'damage' (creases) must look physical and tactile.
Color palette must remain muted and vintage.

mustAchieve: Balanced legibility of text vs. image
Consistent lighting between portrait and texture

postGenerationChecks: Does the image feel like a physical object?
Is the text properly distressed to match the background?
Are the white 'cracks' distributed naturally across the frame?
Is the emotional impact of the portrait preserved through the overlay?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a grain-heavy film portrait with a high-contrast 'folded paper' texture map, then layer semi-transparent, bold sans-serif typography arranged in a grid to simulate a government form.
